questions.html:
What is the expected RTL synthesis output of the following piece of RTL code?
module top(a, b, c, s, en, out1, out2);
input a, b, c, s, en;
output out1, out2;
reg out1, out2;

always @(*) begin
 if (s==1'b0)
out1 = a;
 else
out1 = b;
end

always @(*) begin
 if (en==1'b1)
out2 = c;
  end
endmodule
options: Both out1 and out2 driven by latches
Both out1 and out2 driven by flip-flops
Both out1 and out2 driven by 2-to-1 multiplexers
out1 driven by a latch and out2 driven by a 2-to-1 multiplexer
out1 driven by a latch and out2 driven by a flip-flop
out1 driven by a flip-flop and out2 driven by a 2-to-1 multiplexer
out1 driven by a flip-flop and out2 driven by a latch
out1 driven by a 2-to-1 multiplexer and out2 driven by a latch
out1 driven by a 2-to-1 multiplexer and out2 driven by a flip-flop

questions.html:
What will be the typical RTL synthesis result of the following piece of RTL code?
module top1(in1, clk, out1);
input in1, clk;
output out1;
reg reg1, reg2, reg3, out1;

always @(posedge clk)
begin
 reg1 = in1;
 reg2 = reg1;
 reg3 = reg2;
 out1 = reg3;
end
endmodule
